worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.summary: Curl into a fire wheel and roll in the aimed direction, grinding over every enemy along the way and possibly burning them. Starting to roll thaws the user; it can also roll harmlessly with no target.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.description: The rolling wheel deals about %1$s contact damage; it rolls up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block wheel radius.

Targets after the first take %1$s of the power; a hit on a target that is not burning yet has a %2$s chance to burn it and shoves it %3$s blocks along the roll. The burn lasts %4$s, halving physical attacks and costing about 1/16 of maximum health every 5 s; Fire-types and other naturally immune targets cannot be lit. Hits do not stop the roll.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.fierce.on: Blaze Wheel: much higher burn chance, slower and shorter roll - trade the roll for lasting ignition.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.fierce.off: Gale Wheel: higher power, roll distance and roll speed and a faster rhythm, but it barely ignites anything - better for rolling through a line.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, cost %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.growth.0: From level %1$s the wheel power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.growth.1: From level %1$s the wheel power rises to %2$s and the burn chance to %3$s%%.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.use.0: Roll over a group of foes packed together
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.use.1: Grind down a target that is already in your face
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.use.2: Borrow the fire to melt ice off your own body
On: much higher burn chance, slower and shorter roll - trade the roll for lasting ignition. Off (Gale Wheel): higher power, roll distance and roll speed and a faster rhythm, but it barely ignites anything.
It only starts a roll within this distance; it closes in first. The range is short, so a large value rarely matters.
On: targets that are not burning yet come first, spreading the wheel's fire; off: plain melee ordering.
On: the more enemies packed around a target the higher it ranks - the wheel grinds over a line of them; off: it only eyes one target.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.description: It grinds through at most %1$s enemies on the way, settling each target only once; it stops early when the roll distance is spent, when it hits a wall or when it is blocked.
Starting the roll cures the user's own freeze.
